column1: Table 13 | Balance of benefits and harms When there was evidence to determine the balance of medical benefits and harms of an intervention to a patient, conclusions were categorized as follows: K For statistically significant benefit or harm, report as ‘benefit [or harm] of drug X.’ K For non–statistically significant benefit or harm, report as ‘possible benefit [or harm] of drug X. K In instances where studies are inconsistent, report as ‘possible benefit [or harm] of drug X. K ‘No difference’ can only be reported if a study is not imprecise. K ‘Insufficient evidence’ is reported if imprecision is a factor.
